Current operational performance is poor, with a negative return on capital employed of -3.8% [E11] and a negative return on equity of -5.2% [E12, E25, E57]. Furthermore, the company has been flagged for a low three-year ROE of -0.33% [E51] and offers no income to shareholders with a 0.00% dividend yield [E3]. Despite these low book multiples, the persistent lack of profitability and high P/E suggest the business is fundamentally overextended [E5, E11, E12].
